title: Cutoff-uniform quadratic-heat bound for the diagonal-Gaussian A1 current proxy
purpose: Upgrade the finite diagonal-Gaussian Fourier heat screen to an explicit cutoff-uniform comparison bound for every heat exponent s>=2, while retaining the proxy-only boundary.

analytic_contract.inverse_square_tail: For M>=1, sum_{m=1}^M m^(-2)<2 by 1/m^2<=1/(m(m-1)) for m>=2 and telescoping.
analytic_contract.convolution: Split p by |p|_infty<=|r|_infty/2 and its complement; each branch costs 4^covariance_power times the l1 proxy bound.
analytic_contract.charge: For s>=2, |r|_2^2/(1+(1+|r|_2^2)^(s/2))<=1, so the shell sum gives a cutoff-independent majorant.
analytic_contract.comparison_only: The bound applies only to the declared diagonal Gaussian proxy and is not an A1 production q-ledger.

drop one of the two convolution split regions
change the covariance power without recomputing the split multiplier

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing proxy theorem only. It supplies a cutoff-uniform comparison bound for the explicit diagonal Gaussian Fourier current at heat exponent s>=2. next_action: Use the uniform proxy bound only as a comparison input. The next production obligation remains a hash-pinned heat_root_incidence and raw-current/q-ledger owner on the same A1 cylinder; rerun R-192 only after those fields exist.
